constraints.rule: Target must not be exactly computable from <= budget legal or visible channels.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Declare target dependency set, legal channel set, budget, and an independent static check for exact legal-channel computability.

constraints.rule: Any oracle computation using only legal visible channels within budget must be registered and scored as a fair baseline.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Emit oracle field-access manifest, legal query trace, oracle-as-baseline row, and reject if oracle-as-baseline enters the oracle equivalence band.

constraints.rule: Oracle may not read hidden_state, answer_key, future labels, target aliases, or unqueried values.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Run answer-key diagnostic oracle separately from visible-channel budget-faithful oracle; answer-key oracle may not support promotion.

constraints.rule: Graph/cache/table baselines must be structurally disadvantaged on heldout generalization, not absent or partial.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Run full six-member graph-cache family and require family_max below oracle minus band.

constraints.rule: Train/test split must defeat memorization and simple legal-channel compute on the identical heldout split.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Require lookup/NN, exhaustive legal query, fitted learner, and strongest classical method on the same heldout episodes; low lookup alone cannot support promotion.

constraints.rule: Fitted legal-channel learner and strongest applicable classical method must be present and expected to remain below oracle.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Record real fit evidence, anti-stub guard, ml_library_used or equivalent, train rows consumed, and heldout score.

constraints.rule: Passive visible values must not encode the target at value level.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Run full passive value-decoder family and positive-control leakage scan; require passive family max below passive floor.

constraints.rule: Metrics must be balanced and must not reward predict_all, predict_none, constant-k, random, majority, or size-only predictors.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Use balanced macro-F1 plus per-class precision and recall floors; run degenerate and size-only controls.

constraints.rule: Budget-faithful visible oracle must have enough legitimate signal to exceed the oracle floor before headroom can be assessed.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Predeclare oracle signal source, expected floor, and reject underpowered surfaces before interpreting baseline gaps.

constraints.rule: Baseline battery may not rely on aliases and may not omit mandatory compute, graph/cache, passive, degenerate, replay, fitted, or classical producers.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Every baseline row must record producer_function, source_body_hash, prediction_vector_hash, input_field_manifest, strategy_signature, baseline_family, independence_family, and consumed_by_final_verdict.

constraints.rule: Each sketch must state the strongest false explanation before any run and map it to A1-A9.
constraints.verification_requirement_for_003a: Reject sketches with no explicit A1-A9 self-attack mapping and no expected strongest cheap baseline.

claim_ceiling: Phase-0 environment design-constraint synthesis only. No headroom confirmation. No Gate1 pass. No mechanism validity. No candidate feasibility. No runtime/mainline effect. No agency/autonomy/consciousness/EGO readiness.
